minutes.headline: Cable committee heard no town space exists for a new studio; encoder purchase awaits quotes and an email vote.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee questioned town staff about the rent it pays and described its studio space needs. It was told the Select Board is revising the TC Passios building committee's charge and that no other town space is free. The manager's report covered a new streaming encoder, the FY23 budget draft and finances; December minutes were approved by roll call.

attendees.role: member, arrived after roll call; chairs the meeting

public_comment.topic: A speaker asked why the committee pays rent to the town if the manager's salary is paid through the enterprise, and what defines an enterprise.

votes.outcome: passed (roll call, all heard in favor)

budget_items.topic: Rent charged to the cable enterprise
budget_items.what_was_said: Staff said rent and health insurance are indirect costs charged to enterprise accounts by a square-footage class unchanged for years. Whether a bigger building would change it was called hypothetical.
Members said the budget has money to build but not to equip, and that municipal construction costs run well above normal.
Heather said the revised charge would look at debt capacity because estimates were inflated by pandemic, supply and labor conditions.
The manager said encoders range in price and that quotes will follow town procurement policy once the streaming vendor recommends one.
figures_as_heard: sixteen hundred to thirty three hundred dollars

budget_items.what_was_said: The monthly plan would need to move to an unlimited plan for the encoder to work easily; the vendor will send the cost.
A rough draft proposes equipment maintenance and capital equipment lines; the manager noted old Macs and new cameras.
Members said only expected income can be budgeted, so retained earnings are not available, and expected income is around a set amount.
IT fixed a broken laptop screen so no new laptop was needed.
November Comcast revenue was reported as above a set amount and higher than the prior quarter.
The November Comcast payment was recorded in December; interest was noted as declining.
Payroll is about halfway spent at the midpoint of FY22, on target, though more money may be needed.
An NDI license for one encoder model was found.

decisions.decision: The manager will send the full encoder package to the chair for a no-discussion email vote rather than waiting for the next meeting.
Heather agreed to provide a list of town-held properties, including tax lien properties, via the collector.

what_happened.line: The cable committee was told the town has no free space for a new studio, and the Select Board is revising the TC Passios building committee's charge.
The committee's manager will send the full streaming encoder package to the chair for an email vote with no discussion, instead of waiting for the next meeting.
Staff said rent and health insurance are indirect costs charged to the cable enterprise by a square-footage class unchanged for years.
The manager presented a rough FY23 budget draft with equipment maintenance and capital equipment lines; payroll was reported on target at the midpoint of FY22.
December minutes were approved by roll call, and the next meeting was set for February 7, 2022.

why_it_matters: The cable committee is paid from an enterprise account rather than general taxes, so rent charged to it and the lack of a town-owned studio decide how far its money goes for local meeting coverage.
The encoder and streaming-plan upgrade will be bought under town procurement policy, and the vote on it may happen by email outside a posted meeting.
watch_next: The February 7, 2022 meeting, and the email vote on the encoder package before it.
The Select Board's revised charge for the TC Passios building committee, which is to look at debt capacity.
